steps.en: The archival list is generated automatically every day
steps.id: Daftar archival dibuat otomatis setiap hari
steps.why_en: The automatic daily run is switched off in the production settings in the repo.
steps.why_id: Jadwal harian otomatis dimatikan di pengaturan produksi dalam repo.

steps.en: Notices are picked by suspension status and archival reason
steps.id: Notice dipilih berdasarkan status suspension dan alasan archival

steps.en: Only old suspensions of REPCCS notices are included
steps.id: Hanya suspension lama dari notice REPCCS yang masuk

steps.en: A fixed-format list file is built from the picked notices
steps.id: File daftar berformat tetap dibuat dari notice yang dipilih

steps.en: The file is encrypted and sent to REPCCS
steps.id: File dienkripsi lalu dikirim ke REPCCS
steps.why_en: Notices are marked as sent before delivery is confirmed, so a failed send is never retried.
steps.why_id: Notice ditandai terkirim sebelum pengiriman pasti berhasil, jadi kegagalan tidak dikirim ulang.
